info.title: DakFlare Edge API
info.summary: Sovereign multi-platform messaging hub, Android SMS gateway, Wasm flow engine, and agent control plane on Cloudflare Workers.

DeviceP256Auth.name: X-Signature
DeviceP256Auth.description:
ECDSA P-256 (IEEE P1363 64-byte base64) over METHOD
PATH
X-Timestamp
X-Nonce
SHA256(body). Requires X-Device-Id, X-Timestamp (13-digit UTC ms, ±300s), X-Nonce (32 hex chars), and X-Signature. Query strings are forbidden.

AgentBearerToken.description: Scoped agent token prefixed with dkf_agt_. Costly scopes also require a live time-boxed authority grant.

AdminMachineToken.description: ADMIN_TOKEN paired with X-Dakflare-Client: cli (or binding).

BetterAuthSession.name: __Secure-better-auth.session_token
BetterAuthSession.description: Host-only HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Lax operator session cookie (7-day TTL).

WebhookHmac.name: x-dakflare-signature
WebhookHmac.description: sha256=<lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 over raw body bytes>, paired with x-dakflare-delivery.

idempotency_key.description: Optional deduplication key; retries with the same key return the original command_id with replayed: true.

ConnectorSecret.description: Credential fields for the connector channel. The object is sealed with AES-256-GCM and is never returned. Required fields depend on the channel: whatsapp needs appSecret, verifyToken, accessToken; messenger needs appSecret, verifyToken and accessToken or pageAccessToken; instagram needs appSecret, verifyToken, accessToken; telegram needs botToken and secretToken.

ConnectorView.description: Public connector shape. The sealed credential and its hash are never included.

auth_mode.description: Stored authentication mode; null for channels that do not use one.

secret_set.description: True when a sealed credential exists. The value is never returned.

received_at.description: Epoch milliseconds or an ISO timestamp. Must be within 180 days in the past and 24 hours in the future.

Template.description: An operator-authored message template. `variables` is derived from the body's `{{name}}` tokens at write time.

Contact.description: An audience row: a recipient the operator chose to message, with the variables it carries.

attrs.description: Columns from the import that are not reserved.

timezone.description: IANA zone; UTC when the import value is unknown.

ScheduledMessage.description: A row in the D1 schedule. `id` is also the SMS command id for a device target. Timestamps are epoch milliseconds.

PacingPolicy.description: A per-target token bucket and quiet window. Stored in `pacing_policies` and snapshotted onto each scheduled row.

post.summary: Register a per-account channel connector and seal its credential
post.description: Requires an owner/admin session or the ADMIN_TOKEN machine actor. A dkf_agt_ agent token and a member session are refused by assertHuman and the mutating-role check. The secret is sealed with AES-256-GCM using WEBHOOK_SECRET_KEY and is never returned.

get.description: Public by design. Returns the hub.challenge as text/plain when hub.mode=subscribe and hub.verify_token matches the connector verify token in constant time. Implemented for WhatsApp, Messenger, and Instagram; Telegram returns 405.

403.description: Invalid verify token, missing parameters, or connector disabled

404.description: No connector resolves for this channel and id

405.description: Method not used for this channel (Telegram)

503.description: The sealed credential could not be opened: connector_secret_unavailable

post.description: Public by design: the platform signature over the raw body is the credential. Resolves the connector from KV (D1 on a miss), refuses a disabled connector, reads the raw bytes once (256 KiB cap), verifies the platform signature, parses, and hands events to the per-account ChannelConnection Durable Object. A 200 means accepted or deduplicated, not written to D1. WhatsApp coexistence stores only changes[].field === "messages"; echoes and history are skipped by name.

parameters.name: connector_id
parameters.description: Connector id or platform account id.

200.description: Events accepted or deduplicated by the Durable Object

404.description: Unknown connector, or webhook ingress not implemented for the channel (sms)

500.description: The Durable Object could not ingest the events: ingest_unavailable

post.summary: P-256 signed personal-channel batch from the Android notification bridge
post.description: Authenticates with the same P-256 device signature as every other device route. Accepts at most 500 rows and 262,144 bytes for the whole request; the auth step enforces the byte cap before JSON.parse. Rows are grouped by channel and handed to CHANNEL_CONN.getByName(`${channel}:${device_id}`), so dedupe, the 24-hour window, and the ingest queue match the official connector path. A 202 means the events reached the Durable Object.

device_id.description: Optional; if present it must match the signing device.

post.summary: Render a template and count SMS segments
post.description: Pure rendering and segment accounting. `vars` values must be strings or finite numbers; other types are ignored. `used` lists the variables consumed, `missing` the tokens with no value.

units.description: Septets for GSM-7, UTF-16 code units for UCS-2.

remaining.description: Units free in the last segment.

400.description: Malformed JSON or `vars` is not an object

get.description: Returns at most 200 contacts, newest first. `total` and `opted_out` describe the channel filter only, ignoring `opt_out`, so a console can show both sides of the split.

post.summary: Import contacts from CSV or JSON
post.description: Requires an owner or admin. Accepts a raw `text/csv` body with a header row, or `application/json` with a `contacts` array. Each row needs a `peer` (or `phone`); rows without a usable peer are counted in `skipped`. Imported rows upsert on `(channel, peer)`.

400.description: No contacts, `contacts` is not an array, or malformed JSON

403.description: Agent token, webhook turn, or member session refused

413.description: Body exceeds the import size cap

get.description: Returns at most 200 rows ordered by `send_at` ascending. A member session and the machine actor may read; an agent token may not.

post.description: Requires an owner or admin. Validates the target (a registered device for `sms`, an enabled `worker_do` connector otherwise), resolves the timezone, snapshots the pacing policy and stores the row before waking the Scheduler Durable Object. A template is a WhatsApp-only platform object.

target_id.description: A device_id for `sms`, otherwise a connector id on that channel.

to_peer.description: Recipient address, normalised for the channel.

timezone.description: IANA zone. Defaults to the contact's zone, then UTC.

idempotency_key.description: At most one row per key; a repeat returns the original row.

policy.description: Per-message overrides layered over the target's stored pacing policy.

200.description: The same idempotency key already created this row; it is returned unchanged

400.description: Validation error (bad_channel, bad_target, bad_peer, bad_body, bad_send_at, bad_template, bad_campaign, bad_vars, bad_sim_slot, bad_idempotency_key, template_channel, template_not_found, unknown_device, connector_not_found, or bad_timezone)

409.description: Idempotency key already used by an unreadable row; also connector_disabled or connector_edge_device

503.description: The row is stored but the Scheduler could not be woken; retry

delete.description: Requires an owner or admin. Only a row still in `scheduled` can be cancelled; the D1 update is the cancellation authority.

409.description: The row is no longer cancellable

get.description: Returns at most 200 policies, most recently updated first.

put.summary: Upsert a pace and quiet window for a target
put.description: Requires an owner or admin. All six fields are required and bounded: min_interval_ms 1000..3600000, jitter_pct 0..50, max_per_hour 1..3600, quiet hours 0..23, and a known IANA timezone. A later edit does not rewrite rows already queued.

400.description: Unknown IANA zone; also bad_target_type, bad_target, bad_min_interval_ms, bad_jitter_pct, bad_max_per_hour, or bad_quiet_hours

post.description: Human-only, like connector creation. Opens the sealed credential and calls Telegram's `setWebhook` with the connector's secret token. The bot token is never returned or written to the audit detail. A failure records `last_error` on the connector.

409.description: The connector is not a Telegram connector; also telegram_bot_token_missing

503.description: The sealed credential could not be opened
